answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 27141 Country: India Title: I just wanted to know that is it necessary for womens and men to take bath (baal dhona jaruri hai kya) from head after sexual intercourse? Question: Assalam Walai Kum, I just wanted to know that is it necessary for womens and men to take bath (baal dhona jaruri hai kya) from head after sexual intercourse? Please Reply. Answer ID: 27141 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1979/1585/B=1431) It is necessary for men to wash the head hair completely. But for women, it is enough to take the water in the root of hair. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
